article.story: DES MOINES, Iowa -- — Jon Carroll totaled 21 points and 11 rebounds to lead Drake to a 75-68 victory over Southern on Sunday. Dre Kindell scored 17 points for the Bulldogs (2-0) and Owen Larson added 11 points. Malik Ferguson led the way for the Jaguars (0-3) with 17 points. Daniel Dormu added 15 points and five assists. Drake took the lead with 3:26 left in the first half and did not trail again. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
